high_level_description: The image is a news article headline and synopsis about Honda's new electric vehicle, the Prologue. The headline reads: "Honda's new electric vehicle is quietly creeping up on Tesla." Below the headline is a photograph of the blue Honda Prologue SUV parked on a dirt path surrounded by trees and a scenic view of water in the background. The synopsis provides details about the sales performance of the Prologue. It states that Honda sold roughly 13,000 Prologues, its mid-sized electric SUV, in the three months ending September 30.
